passives.name: Oath of Meteos
passives.description: (Passive Effect) When an enemy uses a non-attack skill, recovers [Buff_V_4076002_17_2] Weakness Gauge. Increases damage dealt proportional to the number of debuffs on the caster, but reduces it if the target has a Barrier. Against non-Water enemies, reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_armor_common_1], increases damage dealt, and reduces damage taken. Against Water enemies, reduces damage dealt and increases damage taken.

buffs.summary: +15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has element disadvantage
−50% damage to boss if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
